title: Preserve the minus sign in transaction history amounts
prompt:
Fix the displayed debit amount in the history response; work on the assigned branch you are on. The only production file to edit is apps/web/src/app/api/v1/history/route.ts. At apps/web/src/app/api/v1/history/route.ts:40, the formatter supplies an empty prefix for negative values and then uses Math.abs, so a posting with amountCents=-499 becomes "$4.99" instead of "-$4.99". Lines 38-40 expose both the negative amount_cents and the contradictory display string. A local execution of the real GET handler with stubbed dependencies reproduced this exact output.

Change only the display formatter to prefix negative values with a minus sign, preserving the existing positive plus sign, dollar symbol, two decimal places, and numeric amount_cents. Zero should retain its existing "+$0.00" representation. Do not change pagination, ledger calculations, response fields, or authentication.

Add tests/api/history-debit-sign.test.mjs using node:test and the stripTypeScriptTypes/compileFunction loading approach demonstrated in tests/security/funding-runtime.test.mjs. Stub authentication as an already resolved fixture and replace only transport/framework dependencies. Execute the actual GET handler for -499, 499, -1, and 0; assert both display strings and unchanged numeric values. Run node --test tests/api/history-debit-sign.test.mjs and node --test tests/security/*.test.mjs. Keep the change offline: no credentials, external requests, payments, sends, deployments, migrations, workflow or package.json edits. Do not commit or push.
